Capture current permitted RGB, same-frame measured joint/EE/gripper state and budgets. Returns observation_id, state/calibration metadata and images. Optional camera_id with roi/scale inspects a zoomed single-view crop of the current observation on demand without advancing simulation or replacing the current observation_id. No hidden object/score access. summary avoids repeating unchanged calibration; full repeats it. Examples (replace IDs/pixels with actual saved evidence): {}
Input field guide (use only fields applicable to the selected mode/kind):
input: Type: object. Object rules: detail is one of ["summary","full"] when supplied; only declared fields.
camera_id: Camera ID present in the selected observation, such as cam_head or cam_right_wrist. Optional unless roi is supplied or scale differs from 1; omission returns the current views. Type: string.
roi: Original-image integer pixels [x,y,width,height], fully in bounds; use the recorded crop transform to convert enlarged-image coordinates. Optional crop; requires camera_id and positive width/height. Type: array; Minimum items: 4; Maximum items: 4.
roi[]: Type: integer.
scale: Optional integer enlargement 1..4, default 1. A value other than 1 requires camera_id; changes displayed pixels, not source geometry. Type: integer; Default: 1; Minimum (inclusive): 1; Maximum (inclusive): 4.
detail: Optional summary/full. Omission uses the actor's configured display default (normally summary) or full for program calls; full repeats original evidence/metadata. Type: string; Allowed: ["summary","full"].

Capture current permitted RGB, same-frame measured joint/EE/gripper state and budgets. Returns observation_id, state/calibration metadata and images. Optional image_delivery selects 'none' (0 images; fast numeric state refresh), 'focus_roi' (1:1 native-sensor local crops around focus_3d), 'head_only' (cam_head RGB only) or 'all' (all calibrated views). Optional focus_3d projects a 3D sphere (target_m in env_origin m and/or detected 3D object_id such as 'o2', radius_m in m) through calibrated K and measured T_world_camera (including live wrist FK) to 1:1 native-resolution crops without advancing simulation or replacing the current observation_id, returning crop_xywh_px=[crop_x,crop_y,w,h], projected_center_uv_px and full_uv = [crop_x + local_u, crop_y + local_v] for geometry_query. Optional camera_id with manual roi/scale inspects a zoomed single-view crop on demand (mutually exclusive with focus_3d). No hidden object/score access. summary avoids repeating unchanged calibration; full repeats it. Examples (replace IDs/pixels with actual saved evidence): {} ; {"image_delivery":"none"} ; {"focus_3d":{"patch_px":256,"radius_m":0.06,"target_m":[0.0,-0.35,0.8]}} ; {"focus_3d":{"object_id":"o2"},"image_delivery":"focus_roi"}
Input field guide (use only fields applicable to the selected mode/kind):
input: Type: object. Object rules: image_delivery is one of ["none","focus_roi","head_only","all"] when supplied; detail is one of ["summary","full"] when supplied; only declared fields; all of (must not satisfy (requires focus_3d, roi) | if (image_delivery equals "focus_roi"; requires image_delivery), then (requires focus_3d) | must not satisfy (image_delivery is one of ["none","head_only","all"]; requires focus_3d, image_delivery) | must not satisfy (scale does not equal 1; requires focus_3d, scale) | if (image_delivery is one of ["none","all"]; requires image_delivery), then (must not satisfy (at least one of (requires roi | requires focus_3d | requires camera_id | scale does not equal 1; requires scale))) | if (image_delivery equals "head_only"; requires image_delivery), then (must not satisfy (at least one of (requires focus_3d | camera_id does not equal "cam_head"; requires camera_id)))).

roi: Original-image integer pixels [x,y,width,height], fully in bounds; use the recorded crop transform to convert enlarged-image coordinates. Optional manual pixel crop; requires camera_id and positive width/height, and is mutually exclusive with focus_3d and image_delivery='none'/'all'. Type: array; Minimum items: 4; Maximum items: 4.
roi[]: Type: integer.
scale: Optional integer enlargement 1..4, default 1. A value other than 1 requires camera_id and cannot be combined with focus_3d or image_delivery='none'/'all'; changes displayed pixels, not source geometry. Type: integer; Default: 1; Minimum (inclusive): 1; Maximum (inclusive): 4.
image_delivery: Optional visual delivery policy: 'none' (0 images; fast numeric state/budget refresh without sensor image transport), 'focus_roi' (1:1 native-sensor local crops around focus_3d; requires focus_3d), 'head_only' (deliver only cam_head RGB image, skipping wrist images), or 'all' (deliver all calibrated camera RGB views, bypassing adaptive view skipping). Projects the 3D sphere (center target_m, radius radius_m in m, range 0.02..0.40, default 0.08) through calibrated K/D and measured T_world_camera (including live wrist-camera joint FK) and crops 1:1 native sensor pixels (patch_px 128..480, default 256) without downscale-upscale blur. Returns focus_3d.views[] with crop_xywh_px=[crop_x,crop_y,w,h], projected_center_uv_px=[u,v], local_center_uv_px=[local_u,local_v], full_uv_offset_px=[crop_x,crop_y] and pixel_transform; convert any pixel [local_u,local_v] picked on a returned crop back to original full-image coordinates via full_uv = [crop_x + local_u, crop_y + local_v] for direct use in geometry_query (triangulate / pixel_plane). Type: object. Object rules: only declared fields; at least one of (requires target_m | requires object_id).

focus_3d.target_m[]: Type: number.
focus_3d.object_id: Optional detected 3D object ID (1..64 characters, such as 'o2') from the current or latest permitted 3D observation in this episode. Resolves the object's 3D centre_m (in env_origin m) when target_m is omitted, and resolves an adaptive 3D bounding-sphere radius clamped to 0.02..0.40 m when radius_m is omitted. Type: string; Minimum characters: 1; Maximum characters: 64.

Crops 1:1 from the original full-resolution sensor image (display_scale=1, never downscaled then upscaled) and clamps [x, y, width, height] strictly within sensor bounds. Unified bounded robot action. Default mode=preview plans the COMPLETE single/dual-arm stage batch without physics, returns plan_id, cost, exact trajectory and calibrated robot-geometry evidence. Review it, then call this SAME tool with mode=execute and plan_id to execute those exact cached rows. No silent replanning or changed commands. mode=execute_if_clean (or auto_execute_if_clean=true) plans the complete batch, runs motion_safety, grasp_3d_review and geometry_review, and immediately executes in the SAME call when all checks pass with zero warnings/risks (automatically returning the preview plan_id without moving if any warning or risk is detected). mode=direct explicitly previews and immediately executes without returning for model review. Optional plan_update submits or updates task_plan inline in the same call without a separate task_plan round trip. stages are ordered per arm; IDs are unique and depends_on adds cross-arm completion dependencies. move uses grasp_position_m in env_origin metres and angles_deg=[pitch,roll,yaw] world rotations from the top-down reference, not conventional absolute Euler angles. Choose contact_region/contact_depth_m at each stage. Alternatively move uses position_m + quaternion_xyzw for a measured link6/flange target. Supply exactly one complete pose pair. Routes use successive move stages, not via fields. There are no joint/home/reset kinds; a return uses saved measured poses. Every move has its own arm speed and optional gripper_goal_normalized/speed; gripper_motion fractions synchronize that jaw within THIS move. Without fractions its jaw runs after measured arrival. A gripper stage requires goal_normalized (0 closed, 1 open), not gripper or goal. observe requires reason and stops BOTH arms; omit arm for a barrier after both prior arm stages, or name an arm to checkpoint when only that arm arrives. Later stages remain cached. After inspecting RGB, execute the same plan_id to continue only if its current-state validity check passes; otherwise preview a new plan. Optional checkpoint_after_gripper=true (on a grasp/gripper stage or the batch) pauses after a jaw stage before the next move stage (pre-lift) to inspect finger contact and grip_facts in RGB before continuing the cached plan_id; or use grip_guard_preset (non_empty [>=2mm], thin_object [>=0.5mm], rigid_object [>=4mm], wide_object [>=15mm], none) and min_aperture_m/max_aperture_m [0..0.088m] to conditionally pause only when measured_aperture_m falls outside the expected bounds (valid grasps continue into lift without pausing). Use tolerance_preset (tight, normal, relaxed, coarse, unconstrained_orientation) or position_tolerance_m/orientation_tolerance_rad per stage, and set stall_guard_preset="contact_stop" specifically on contact descent/press stages (keep batch default "off" for free-space transits). Use joint_travel_preset (standard, extended, unconstrained) or max_joint_travel_rad/max_backtracking_rad on move stages or the batch when legitimate large wrist rotations need wider travel thresholds. Independent arm sequences overlap. Express paired barriers using depends_on; arrival/closed-jaw commands do not prove contact, support or retention. Shared rows cost one native step; the complete batch retains one 250-step budget including resumed portions. mode=inspect accepts plan_id for cached evidence, action_id for executed measured/planned paths, or trajectory_ref for an existing artifact; path_kind selects measured/planned. Supply observed/estimated obstacles world AABBs and held_objects={left/right: current world AABB} for full-timeline proxy clearance estimates; contact declarations annotate overlaps without suppressing risks. Auxiliary review is reserved; the main model owns execution approval. Geometry risks are advisory, not a joint-collision, environment-collision or shared-object constraint proof. Usage: preview/execute_if_clean/direct require current observation_id and either 1..32 stages, source_plan_id + start_from_stage_id (with optional stage_overrides to recompile remaining stages from current measured state), or plan_id + skip_failed_stage/partial stages (from repair_action); execute accepts plan_id, optional action_id and expected_cursor/expected_revision; inspect requires exactly one plan_id/action_id/trajectory_ref plus inspection options. Example checkpoint preview: {"observation_id":"obs1","stages":[{"id":"check","kind":"observe","reason":"inspect current support"}]}. After reviewing a returned plan: {"mode":"execute","plan_id":"p1","expected_cursor":0,"expected_revision":0}. Explicit continuation after a paused/failed stage: {"mode":"preview","observation_id":"obs2","source_plan_id":"p1","start_from_stage_id":"carry","stage_overrides":{"carry":{"position_tolerance_m":0.015}}} or {"mode":"preview","observation_id":"obs2","plan_id":"p1","skip_failed_stage":true}. Gripper stage syntax: {"id":"open","kind":"gripper","arm":"left","goal_normalized":1}; choose the goal from the intended action.
Input field guide (use only fields applicable to the selected mode/kind):
input: Type: object. Object rules: mode is one of ["preview","execute","inspect","direct","execute_if_clean"] when supplied; detail is one of ["summary","full"] when supplied; only declared fields.
mode: preview (default) plans without physics; execute_if_clean plans and immediately executes when motion_safety, grasp_3d_review and geometry_review have zero warnings/risks (otherwise returns preview plan_id for inspection); execute runs cached plan_id; direct plans and immediately executes; inspect reads saved trajectories. Type: string; Allowed: ["preview","execute","inspect","direct","execute_if_clean"].
auto_execute_if_clean: Preview/execute_if_clean only: optional boolean (default false). When true, automatically executes the planned batch in the same call if status is planned, motion_safety is pass, grasp_3d_review has no warnings/risk_flags, and geometry_review has no risks; otherwise returns the preview plan_id for inspection. Type: boolean.
plan_update: Optional inline task_plan payload {plan?, attention?, ledger?}: atomically submits (if no task_plan exists yet) or updates task_plan in the same call without a separate task_plan round trip. Type: object.
observation_id: Required for preview/execute_if_clean/direct: actual current observation ID grounding the complete batch. Type: string.
action_id: Optional caller-chosen unique execution ID for preview/direct/execute; inspect selects this existing executed action. Never reuse for different commands. Type: string.
plan_id: Required for execute; inspect may select it. Use the ID returned by preview in this active run; only 16 recent plans remain cached. Type: string.
source_plan_id: Preview/direct only: existing plan_id whose stage definitions are reused for explicit continuation from start_from_stage_id. Mutually exclusive with stages. Type: string; Minimum characters: 1.
start_from_stage_id: Preview/direct with source_plan_id: stage ID in source_plan_id to start recompiling from (inclusive of this stage and all subsequent stages) using the current observation_id measured state. Type: string; Minimum characters: 1.
stage_overrides: Preview/direct with source_plan_id: optional object {stage_id: {field: value}} overriding target_pose/pose fields, position_tolerance_m, speed_preset, etc. on selected remaining stages without rewriting all stages. Type: object.
skip_failed_stage: Preview/direct with plan_id only: optional boolean (default false). Set true to skip the failed stage and recompile remaining uncompleted stages from current measured state. Type: boolean.
expected_cursor: Execute only: expected executed native-step count; use next_action returned by preview/checkpoint. Omission uses current cached cursor. Type: integer; Minimum (inclusive): 0.
expected_revision: Execute only: expected plan revision; use returned next_action. Omission uses current cached revision. Type: integer; Minimum (inclusive): 0.
trajectory_ref: Inspect only: existing actor-accessible trajectory artifact reference; mutually exclusive with plan_id/action_id. Type: string.
path_kind: Inspect action feedback only: measured (default) or planned, if listed in available_paths. Omit for preview trajectory artifacts. Type: string.
stages: 1..32 stages total, at most 16 per arm, on one shared execution timeline. Include both arms here for simultaneous motion. List order applies within each arm, not across arms; a global observe creates a barrier between preceding and following stages. A move with an after-arrival jaw goal expands into a motion and a jaw stage and consumes two stage slots. Type: array; Minimum items: 1; Maximum items: 32.

Unified bounded robot action. Default mode=preview plans the COMPLETE single/dual-arm stage batch without physics, returns plan_id, cost, exact trajectory and calibrated robot-geometry evidence. Review it, then call this SAME tool with mode=execute and plan_id to execute those exact cached rows. No silent replanning or changed commands. mode=execute_if_clean (or auto_execute_if_clean=true) plans the complete batch, checks motion_safety, grasp_3d_review and geometry_review, and immediately executes in the SAME call when blocking_risks is empty (returning the preview plan_id without moving if blocking_risks is non-empty; advisory_notes do not block). mode=preflight plans without physics, caches plan_id for mode=execute, and returns numerical costs/tolerances/advisory_notes with 0 images. mode=direct explicitly previews and immediately executes without returning for model review. Optional plan_update submits or updates task_plan inline in the same call without a separate task_plan round trip. stages are ordered per arm; IDs are unique and depends_on adds cross-arm completion dependencies. move uses grasp_position_m in env_origin metres and angles_deg=[pitch,roll,yaw] world rotations from the top-down reference, not conventional absolute Euler angles. Choose contact_region/contact_depth_m at each stage. Alternatively move uses position_m + quaternion_xyzw for a measured link6/flange target. Supply exactly one complete pose pair. Routes use successive move stages, not via fields. There are no joint/home/reset kinds; a return uses saved measured poses. Every move has its own arm speed and optional gripper_goal_normalized/speed; gripper_motion fractions synchronize that jaw within THIS move. Without fractions its jaw runs after measured arrival. A gripper stage requires goal_normalized (0 closed, 1 open), not gripper or goal. observe requires reason and stops BOTH arms; omit arm for a barrier after both prior arm stages, or name an arm to checkpoint when only that arm arrives. Later stages remain cached. After inspecting RGB, execute the same plan_id to continue only if its current-state validity check passes; otherwise preview a new plan. Optional checkpoint_after_gripper=true (on a grasp/gripper stage or the batch) pauses after a jaw stage before the next move stage (pre-lift) to inspect finger contact and grip_facts in RGB before continuing the cached plan_id; or use grip_guard_preset (non_empty [>=2mm], thin_object [>=0.5mm], rigid_object [>=4mm], wide_object [>=15mm], none) and min_aperture_m/max_aperture_m [0..0.088m] to conditionally pause only when measured_aperture_m falls outside the expected bounds (valid grasps continue into lift without pausing). Use tolerance_preset (tight, normal, relaxed, coarse, unconstrained_orientation) or position_tolerance_m/orientation_tolerance_rad per stage, and set stall_guard_preset="contact_stop" specifically on contact descent/press stages (keep batch default "off" for free-space transits). Use joint_travel_preset (standard, extended, unconstrained) or max_joint_travel_rad/max_backtracking_rad on move stages or the batch when legitimate large wrist rotations need wider travel thresholds. On open-jaw grasp moves (jaw >= 0.90), allow_jaw_symmetry=true is enabled by default (set false for strict finger polarity) so exact 180-deg parallel-jaw symmetry resolves wrist-wrap or IK failures automatically (reporting resolved_angles_deg); set allow_approach_tilt=true explicitly only when -15/+15/-30/+30 deg approach tilts are permitted; closed/holding moves never flip or tilt. Independent arm sequences overlap. Express paired barriers using depends_on; arrival/closed-jaw commands do not prove contact, support or retention. Shared rows cost one native step; the complete batch retains one 250-step budget including resumed portions. mode=inspect accepts plan_id for cached evidence, action_id for executed measured/planned paths, or trajectory_ref for an existing artifact; path_kind selects measured/planned. Supply observed/estimated obstacles world AABBs and held_objects={left/right: current world AABB} for full-timeline proxy clearance estimates; contact declarations annotate overlaps without suppressing risks. Auxiliary review is reserved; the main model owns execution approval. Geometry risks are advisory, not a joint-collision, environment-collision or shared-object constraint proof. Usage: preview/preflight/execute_if_clean/direct require current observation_id and either 1..32 stages, source_plan_id + start_from_stage_id (with optional stage_overrides to recompile remaining stages from current measured state), or plan_id + skip_failed_stage/partial stages (from repair_action); execute accepts plan_id, optional action_id, optional image_delivery and expected_cursor/expected_revision; inspect requires exactly one plan_id/action_id/trajectory_ref plus inspection options. Example checkpoint preview: {"observation_id":"obs1","stages":[{"id":"check","kind":"observe","reason":"inspect current support"}]}. After reviewing a returned plan: {"mode":"execute","plan_id":"p1","expected_cursor":0,"expected_revision":0}. Explicit continuation after a paused/failed stage: {"mode":"preview","observation_id":"obs2","source_plan_id":"p1","start_from_stage_id":"carry","stage_overrides":{"carry":{"position_tolerance_m":0.015}}} or {"mode":"preview","observation_id":"obs2","plan_id":"p1","skip_failed_stage":true}. Gripper stage syntax: {"id":"open","kind":"gripper","arm":"left","goal_normalized":1}; choose the goal from the intended action.

Type: number; Minimum (inclusive): 0.1; Maximum (inclusive): 300.

obstacles[].min_m[]: Type: number.

preview (default) plans without physics; execute_if_clean plans and immediately executes when motion_safety, grasp_3d_review and geometry_review have zero warnings/risks (otherwise returns preview plan_id for inspection); execute runs cached plan_id; direct plans and immediately executes; inspect reads saved trajectories.

preview (default) plans without physics and renders the trajectory overlay; execute_if_clean plans and executes in one call when blocking_risks is empty (otherwise returns preview plan_id for inspection); preflight plans without physics with 0 images and caches plan_id; execute runs cached plan_id; direct plans and immediately executes; inspect reads saved trajectories.

pool.description: Preview/execute_if_clean only: optional boolean (default false). When true, automatically executes the planned batch in the same call if status is planned, motion_safety is pass, grasp_3d_review has no warnings/risk_flags, and geometry_review has no risks; otherwise returns the preview plan_id for inspection.
Optional inline task_plan payload {plan?, attention?, ledger?}: atomically submits (if no task_plan exists yet) or updates task_plan in the same call without a separate task_plan round trip.
Required for preview/execute_if_clean/direct: actual current observation ID grounding the complete batch.
Optional caller-chosen unique execution ID for preview/direct/execute; inspect selects this existing executed action. Never reuse for different commands.
Required for execute; inspect may select it. Use the ID returned by preview in this active run; only 16 recent plans remain cached.
Preview/direct only: existing plan_id whose stage definitions are reused for explicit continuation from start_from_stage_id. Mutually exclusive with stages.
Preview/direct with source_plan_id: stage ID in source_plan_id to start recompiling from (inclusive of this stage and all subsequent stages) using the current observation_id measured state.

Preview/direct with source_plan_id: optional object {stage_id: {field: value}} overriding target_pose/pose fields, position_tolerance_m, speed_preset, etc. on selected remaining stages without rewriting all stages.
Preview/direct with plan_id only: optional boolean (default false). Set true to skip the failed stage and recompile remaining uncompleted stages from current measured state.
Execute only: expected executed native-step count; use next_action returned by preview/checkpoint. Omission uses current cached cursor.
Execute only: expected plan revision; use returned next_action. Omission uses current cached revision.
Inspect only: existing actor-accessible trajectory artifact reference; mutually exclusive with plan_id/action_id.
Inspect action feedback only: measured (default) or planned, if listed in available_paths. Omit for preview trajectory artifacts.

id.description: Unique ID within this batch; referenced by depends_on and returned stage results.

arm.description: Required for move/gripper. For observe, omit to wait for both arms' prior stages; name an arm to pause both when that arm reaches this checkpoint.

depends_on.description: Stage IDs that must finish before this stage starts. Same-arm order is automatic; add cross-arm dependencies only when physically needed. Independent left/right stages need none.

kind.description: move requires arm and one complete pose pair; gripper requires arm and goal_normalized; observe requires reason. joint/home/reset are not supported kinds.

grasp_position_m.description: Move only: target center between fingers at the selected contact section [x,y,z] in env_origin metres, paired with angles_deg. This is not either individual finger surface. Tool offset is converted once; do not add a manual offset.

angles_deg.description: Move only: [pitch,roll,yaw] extrinsic world +x,+y,+z rotations from the top-down reference, in degrees; [0,0,0] points tool +x down world -z, jaw opening along world -x. Bounds [-180,180], [-90,90], [-180,180]; not absolute Euler angles. The requested orientation is preserved during planning; if infeasible, explicitly choose different angles and preview again.

position_m.description: Move only: target link6/flange [x,y,z] in env_origin metres, paired with quaternion_xyzw; mutually exclusive with grasp pose/contact fields.

quaternion_xyzw.description: Move only: link6/flange orientation [x,y,z,w], a unit quaternion in env_origin; paired with position_m.

contact_region.description: Grasp move only: pad_center (default, fingertips 7.5 mm beyond target along tool +x), finger_middle (27.5 mm toward palm, fingertips 35 mm beyond target), or fingertip (at target). Selects a longitudinal section, not a contacting finger or proof of object contact; keep fingertips above rigid supports on top-down grasps. Choose this or contact_depth_m.

contact_depth_m.description: Grasp move only: custom depth from pad_center in metres [-0.0075,0.0625], positive toward palm; choose this or contact_region.

speed_scale.description: Move only: arm trajectory speed multiplier [0.25,2]; choose this or speed_preset. Omission uses run default.

speed_preset.description: Move only: named arm speed; slower=0.5, slow=0.8, careful=0.9, normal=1, fast=1.25, faster=1.5. Choose this or speed_scale.

gripper_speed_scale.description: Jaw speed multiplier [0.25,1], default 1; choose this or gripper_speed_preset. On move requires gripper_goal_normalized.

gripper_speed_preset.description: Jaw speed: slower=0.5, slow=0.8 or normal=1; choose this or gripper_speed_scale. On move requires gripper_goal_normalized.

gripper_goal_normalized.description: Move only: jaw target [0,1], 0 closed and 1 open; omission preserves the last commanded goal, not the measured opening or a guaranteed grip force. Runs after measured arrival unless gripper_motion is supplied. A tracking failure stops the batch before this after-arrival command.

start_fraction.description: Start fraction of move in [0,1), strictly before end_fraction.

end_fraction.description: End fraction of move in (0,1], strictly after start_fraction.

gripper_motion.description: Move only: synchronize jaw motion over start_fraction..end_fraction of this move, with start < end; requires gripper_goal_normalized.

checkpoint_after_gripper.description: Move (with gripper_goal_normalized) or gripper stage only: optional on-demand boolean (default inherits batch checkpoint_after_gripper, which defaults to false). Set true to unconditionally pause both arms at the stage boundary before dependent move stages so you can inspect RGB and grip_facts and resume the cached plan_id.

grip_guard_preset.description: Move or gripper stage: optional aperture guard preset (none, non_empty [min 0.002m], thin_object [min 0.0005m], rigid_object [min 0.004m], wide_object [min 0.015m]). Choose from object thickness/rigidity: use rigid_object/wide_object (or min_aperture_m) on rigid blocks/bottles/tubes so an empty closure pauses automatically while a valid grasp continues; use thin_object or none on deformable cloth/thin sheets where a pinched jaw closes nearly to 0 m.

min_aperture_m.description: Move or gripper stage: optional minimum expected fingertip aperture in metres [0, 0.088] (full open 88mm, closed 0m; default none/disabled). Pauses with aperture_below_min_m if measured_aperture_m < min_aperture_m; overrides preset lower bound. Note that thin parts (<=3mm such as coins, cards, thin rims or cloth) can read 0.000m when firmly held, so omit min_aperture_m for thin parts.

max_aperture_m.description: Move or gripper stage: optional maximum expected fingertip aperture in metres [0, 0.088] (full open 88mm, closed 0m). Pauses with aperture_above_max_m if measured_aperture_m > max_aperture_m; overrides preset upper bound.

joint_travel_preset.description: Move only: optional joint-travel admission preset: standard (default, total<=pi or excess<pi/2), extended (total<=1.5*pi or excess<pi for wide-arc sweeps, large orientation flips or deformable folding), or unconstrained (disables travel/backtracking rejection while keeping step-budget checks).

max_joint_travel_rad.description: Move only: optional custom per-joint total travel threshold in radians (>0) before backtracking/winding checks apply; overrides joint_travel_preset.

max_backtracking_rad.description: Move only: optional custom per-joint backtracking/periodic-winding excess threshold in radians (>0); overrides joint_travel_preset.

tolerance_preset.description: Move only: named arrival tolerance preset; tight=(0.003 m, 0.05 rad) strictly for final millimeter-clearance pin/slot insertion (avoid tight on tabletop grasps or pushing where PD droop/friction is ~4-6mm), normal=(0.010 m, 0.15 rad, default; requires <=10 mm horizontal alignment with vertical contact/load compliance), relaxed/compliant=(0.015 m, 0.20 rad) for compliant placement, coarse=(0.025 m, 0.35 rad) for large-clearance transit/retract, unconstrained_orientation=(0.015 m, 3.14159 rad) when wrist orientation around a symmetric target is free. Explicit position_tolerance_m, orientation_tolerance_rad or max_upward_dz_m overrides the corresponding component.

position_tolerance_m.description: Move only: measured link6 arrival position tolerance in metres, positive and at most 0.10. Overrides the position component of tolerance_preset (default normal=0.010 m). Tracking failure stops later stages, including gripper commands, and returns endpoint_residual_m={dx_m,dy_m,dz_m,position_error_m,orientation_error_rad}, first_divergence, contact_block_summary, in_hand_tracking_error (true when an object remains held between the fingers at a blocked pose) and next_action.

orientation_tolerance_rad.description: Move only: measured link6 arrival orientation tolerance in radians, in (0, pi]. Overrides the orientation component of tolerance_preset (default normal=0.15 rad).

max_upward_dz_m.description: Move only: optional vertical Z compliance window override in metres [0, 0.15] when horizontal (dx, dy) and orientation are within tolerance and measured Z rests above target (+dz_m <= max_upward_dz_m). Defaults when omitted: max(pos_tol, 0.040 m) with stall_guard_preset="contact_stop" (max(pos_tol, 0.022 m) on open-jaw pre-grasp), max(1.2*pos_tol, 0.025 m) on closed-jaw moves, max(pos_tol, 0.018 m) on other open-jaw moves, and 0 m without contact_stop on tight moves or when pos_tol (the effective position tolerance) is below 0.009 m. Omit to use the preset default, set 0 for strict 3D Z arrival, or set a larger value (e.g. 0.05-0.08 m) when stacking/seating high above target Z. Downward error remains bounded by position_tolerance_m; enabling vertical compliance does not relax orientation_tolerance_rad. Resolved effective_tolerances are reported in stage_results.

stall_guard_preset.description: Move only: real-time tracking divergence early-stop preset; off (default for batch, free-space moves, and pressing spring-loaded levers through resistance), contact_stop (0.020 m stall trigger during motion; stops at first support/object contact when horizontal (dx, dy) is within tolerance and holds the contact pose so attached gripper stages execute), or strict (0.010 m).

max_tracking_divergence_m.description: Move only: custom real-time tracking divergence threshold in metres [0.005, 0.15]; overrides stall_guard_preset.

clearance_preset.description: Move only: optional obstacle-crossing vertical clearance preset (none=0 m, low=0.09 m, normal=0.13 m default, high=0.18 m) when obstacles are supplied; mutually exclusive with clearance_height_m.

clearance_height_m.description: Move only: optional custom obstacle-crossing vertical clearance height in metres [0, 0.25] above obstacle top when obstacles are supplied; mutually exclusive with clearance_preset.

goal_normalized.description: Gripper stage only, required: jaw target [0,1], 0 closed and 1 open. Command completion and measured aperture do not establish object retention. Use this exact field, not gripper, goal, or gripper_goal_normalized.

reason.description: Observe stage only, required nonblank text: what evidence to inspect at this checkpoint.

Defaults when omitted: max(pos_tol, 0.040 m) with stall_guard_preset="contact_stop" (max(pos_tol, 0.022 m) on open-jaw pre-grasp), max(1.2*pos_tol, 0.025 m) on closed-jaw moves, max(pos_tol, 0.018 m) on other open-jaw moves, and 0 m without contact_stop on tight moves or when pos_tol (the effective position tolerance) is below 0.009 m. Omit to use the preset default, set 0 for strict 3D Z arrival, or set a larger value (e.g. 0.05-0.08 m) when stacking/seating high above target Z. Downward error remains bounded by position_tolerance_m; enabling vertical compliance does not relax orientation_tolerance_rad. Resolved effective_tolerances are reported in stage_results.

stall_guard_preset.description: Move only: real-time tracking divergence early-stop preset; off (default for batch, free-space moves, and pressing spring-loaded levers through resistance), contact_stop (0.020 m stall trigger during motion; stops at first support/object contact when horizontal (dx, dy) is within tolerance and holds the contact pose so attached gripper stages execute), or strict (0.010 m).

max_tracking_divergence_m.description: Move only: custom real-time tracking divergence threshold in metres [0.005, 0.15]; overrides stall_guard_preset.

clearance_preset.description: Move only: optional obstacle-crossing vertical clearance preset (none=0 m, low=0.09 m, normal=0.13 m default, high=0.18 m) when obstacles are supplied; mutually exclusive with clearance_height_m.

clearance_height_m.description: Move only: optional custom obstacle-crossing vertical clearance height in metres [0, 0.25] above obstacle top when obstacles are supplied; mutually exclusive with clearance_preset.

checkpoint_after_gripper.description: Move (with gripper_goal_normalized) or gripper stage only: optional on-demand boolean (default inherits batch checkpoint_after_gripper, which defaults to false). grip_guard_preset.description: Move or gripper stage: optional aperture guard preset (none, non_empty [min 0.002m], thin_object [min 0.0005m], rigid_object [min 0.004m], wide_object [min 0.015m]). max_aperture_m.description: Move or gripper stage: optional maximum expected fingertip aperture in metres [0, 0.088] (full open 88mm, closed 0m). Pauses with aperture_above_max_m if measured_aperture_m > max_aperture_m; overrides preset upper bound.

gripper_speed_scale.description: Jaw speed multiplier [0.25,1], default 1; choose this or gripper_speed_preset. On move requires gripper_goal_normalized.

gripper_speed_preset.description: Jaw speed: slower=0.5, slow=0.8 or normal=1; choose this or gripper_speed_scale. On move requires gripper_goal_normalized.

kind.description: move requires arm and one complete pose pair; gripper requires arm and goal_normalized; observe requires reason. joint/home/reset are not supported kinds.

grasp_position_m.description: Move only: target center between fingers at the selected contact section [x,y,z] in env_origin metres, paired with angles_deg. This is not either individual finger surface. Tool offset is converted once; do not add a manual offset.

angles_deg.description: Move only: [pitch,roll,yaw] extrinsic world +x,+y,+z rotations from the top-down reference, in degrees; [0,0,0] points tool +x down world -z, jaw opening along world -x. Bounds [-180,180], [-90,90], [-180,180]; not absolute Euler angles. On open-jaw grasp moves (allow_jaw_symmetry=true by default), if the primary orientation hits IK/joint-travel limits, planning tries strictly the exact 180 deg parallel-jaw SO(3) twin (reporting resolved_angles_deg); approach tilts require explicit allow_approach_tilt=true.

position_m.description: Move only: target link6/flange [x,y,z] in env_origin metres, paired with quaternion_xyzw; mutually exclusive with grasp pose/contact fields.

quaternion_xyzw.description: Move only: link6/flange orientation [x,y,z,w], a unit quaternion in env_origin; paired with position_m.

contact_region.description: Grasp move only: pad_center (default, fingertips 7.5 mm beyond target along tool +x), finger_middle (27.5 mm toward palm, fingertips 35 mm beyond target), or fingertip (at target). Selects a longitudinal section, not a contacting finger or proof of object contact; keep fingertips above rigid supports on top-down grasps. Choose this or contact_depth_m.

contact_depth_m.description: Grasp move only: custom depth from pad_center in metres [-0.0075,0.0625], positive toward palm; choose this or contact_region.

speed_scale.description: Move only: arm trajectory speed multiplier [0.25,2]; choose this or speed_preset. Omission uses run default.

speed_preset.description: Move only: named arm speed; slower=0.5, slow=0.8, careful=0.9, normal=1, fast=1.25, faster=1.5. Choose this or speed_scale.

gripper_speed_scale.description: Jaw speed multiplier [0.25,1], default 1; choose this or gripper_speed_preset. On move requires gripper_goal_normalized.

gripper_speed_preset.description: Jaw speed: slower=0.5, slow=0.8 or normal=1; choose this or gripper_speed_scale. On move requires gripper_goal_normalized.

gripper_goal_normalized.description: Move only: jaw target [0,1], 0 closed and 1 open; omission preserves the last commanded goal, not the measured opening or a guaranteed grip force. Runs after measured arrival unless gripper_motion is supplied. A tracking failure stops the batch before this after-arrival command.

start_fraction.description: Start fraction of move in [0,1), strictly before end_fraction.

end_fraction.description: End fraction of move in (0,1], strictly after start_fraction.

gripper_motion.description: Move only: synchronize jaw motion over start_fraction..end_fraction of this move, with start < end; requires gripper_goal_normalized.

checkpoint_after_gripper.description: Move (with gripper_goal_normalized) or gripper stage only: optional on-demand boolean (default inherits batch checkpoint_after_gripper, which defaults to false). Set true to unconditionally pause both arms at the stage boundary before dependent move stages so you can inspect RGB and grip_facts and resume the cached plan_id.

allow_jaw_symmetry.description: Move only: optional boolean (defaults to true on open-jaw grasp moves when omitted; inherits batch allow_jaw_symmetry when set). When true on an open-jaw move (jaw goal >= 0.90 normalized [0, 1]), if the requested angles_deg (deg) fails cuRobo IK or exceeds joint-travel/wrist-winding thresholds (rad), planning tries strictly the exact 180 deg SO(3) parallel-jaw symmetric twin around the approach axis (0 m contact shift, 0 deg approach tilt), reporting jaw_symmetry_resolved and resolved_angles_deg (deg) in stage_costs and stage_results. Set false for strict finger polarity; never flips or tilts closed/holding moves.

allow_approach_tilt.description: Move only: optional opt-in boolean (default false; inherits batch allow_approach_tilt when set). When explicitly true on an open-jaw grasp move (jaw goal >= 0.90 normalized [0, 1]) and both primary angles_deg (deg) and its exact 180 deg parallel-jaw twin fail cuRobo IK or joint-travel admission (rad), planning additionally searches contact-point-invariant approach tilts (-15, +15, -30, +30 deg around the jaw closing axis while keeping grasp_position_m [x,y,z] in env_origin metres fixed and flange Z >= contact Z - 0.01 m), reporting jaw_symmetry_resolved, approach_tilt_resolved, and resolved_angles_deg (deg). Keep default false on vertical slot/peg/cavity grasps where approach tilt would violate clearance.

grip_guard_preset.description: Move or gripper stage: optional aperture guard preset (none, non_empty [min 0.002m], thin_object [min 0.0005m], rigid_object [min 0.004m], wide_object [min 0.015m]). Choose from object thickness/rigidity: use rigid_object/wide_object (or min_aperture_m) on rigid blocks/bottles/tubes so an empty closure pauses automatically while a valid grasp continues; use thin_object or none on deformable cloth/thin sheets where a pinched jaw closes nearly to 0 m.

min_aperture_m.description: Move or gripper stage: optional minimum expected fingertip aperture in metres [0, 0.088] (full open 88mm, closed 0m; default none/disabled). Pauses with aperture_below_min_m if measured_aperture_m < min_aperture_m; overrides preset lower bound. Note that thin parts (<=3mm such as coins, cards, thin rims or cloth) can read 0.000m when firmly held, so omit min_aperture_m for thin parts.

max_aperture_m.description: Move or gripper stage: optional maximum expected fingertip aperture in metres [0, 0.088] (full open 88mm, closed 0m). Pauses with aperture_above_max_m if measured_aperture_m > max_aperture_m; overrides preset upper bound.

joint_travel_preset.description: Move only: optional joint-travel admission preset: standard (default, total<=pi or excess<pi/2), extended (total<=1.5*pi or excess<pi for wide-arc sweeps, large orientation flips or deformable folding), or unconstrained (disables travel/backtracking rejection while keeping step-budget checks).

max_joint_travel_rad.description: Move only: optional custom per-joint total travel threshold in radians (>0) before backtracking/winding checks apply; overrides joint_travel_preset.

max_backtracking_rad.description: Move only: optional custom per-joint backtracking/periodic-winding excess threshold in radians (>0); overrides joint_travel_preset.

tolerance_preset.description: Move only: named arrival tolerance preset; tight=(0.003 m, 0.05 rad) strictly for final millimeter-clearance pin/slot insertion (avoid tight on tabletop grasps or pushing where PD droop/friction is ~4-6mm), normal=(0.010 m, 0.15 rad, default; requires <=10 mm horizontal alignment with vertical contact/load compliance), relaxed/compliant/seating=(0.015 m, 0.20 rad) for compliant placement, coarse=(0.025 m, 0.35 rad) for large-clearance transit/retract, unconstrained_orientation=(0.015 m, 3.14159 rad) when wrist orientation around a symmetric target is free. Explicit position_tolerance_m, orientation_tolerance_rad, max_upward_dz_m or max_downward_dz_m overrides the corresponding component.

position_tolerance_m.description: Move only: measured link6 arrival position tolerance in metres, positive and at most 0.10. Overrides the position component of tolerance_preset (default normal=0.010 m). Tracking failure stops later stages, including gripper commands, and returns endpoint_residual_m={dx_m,dy_m,dz_m,position_error_m,orientation_error_rad}, first_divergence, contact_block_summary, in_hand_tracking_error (true when an object remains held between the fingers at a blocked pose) and next_action.

orientation_tolerance_rad.description: Move only: measured link6 arrival orientation tolerance in radians, in (0, pi]. Overrides the orientation component of tolerance_preset (default normal=0.15 rad).

max_upward_dz_m.description: Move only: optional upward +Z compliance window in metres [0, 0.15] when horizontal (dx, dy) and orientation are within tolerance and measured Z rests above target (+dz_m <= max_upward_dz_m). Defaults when omitted: 0.040 m when tolerance_preset="compliant"/"seating", max(position_tolerance_m, 0.040 m) when stall_guard_preset="contact_stop", and 0 m on all other moves. Set an explicit positive value (e.g. 0.04-0.12 m) for deep support/seating stops, or 0 for strict 3D Z arrival. Resolved effective_tolerances are reported in preview and stage_results.

max_downward_dz_m.description: Move only: optional downward -Z static payload-droop compliance window in metres [0, 0.15] when horizontal (dx, dy) and orientation are within tolerance and measured Z sags below target under held object weight (-max_downward_dz_m <= dz_m <= 0; default 0 m). Set e.g. max_downward_dz_m=0.020-0.060 m on loaded lift/transport/hover moves when held payload weight causes static joint-PD gravity sag while horizontal (dx, dy) stays aligned.

grip_guard_preset.description: Move or gripper stage: optional aperture guard preset (none, non_empty [min 0.002m], thin_object [min 0.0005m], rigid_object [min 0.004m], wide_object [min 0.015m]). Choose from object thickness/rigidity: use rigid_object/wide_object (or min_aperture_m) on rigid blocks/bottles/tubes so an empty closure pauses automatically while a valid grasp continues; use thin_object or none on deformable cloth/thin sheets where a pinched jaw closes nearly to 0 m.

min_aperture_m.description: Move or gripper stage: optional minimum expected fingertip aperture in metres [0, 0.088] (full open 88mm, closed 0m; default none/disabled). Pauses with aperture_below_min_m if measured_aperture_m < min_aperture_m; overrides preset lower bound. Note that thin parts (<=3mm such as coins, cards, thin rims or cloth) can read 0.000m when firmly held, so omit min_aperture_m for thin parts.

max_aperture_m.description: Move or gripper stage: optional maximum expected fingertip aperture in metres [0, 0.088] (full open 88mm, closed 0m). Pauses with aperture_above_max_m if measured_aperture_m > max_aperture_m; overrides preset upper bound.

joint_travel_preset.description: Move only: optional joint-travel admission preset: standard (default, total<=pi or excess<pi/2), extended (total<=1.5*pi or excess<pi for wide-arc sweeps, large orientation flips or deformable folding), or unconstrained (disables travel/backtracking rejection while keeping step-budget checks).

max_joint_travel_rad.description: Move only: optional custom per-joint total travel threshold in radians (>0) before backtracking/winding checks apply; overrides joint_travel_preset.

max_backtracking_rad.description: Move only: optional custom per-joint backtracking/periodic-winding excess threshold in radians (>0); overrides joint_travel_preset.

tolerance_preset.description: Move only: named arrival tolerance preset; tight=(0.003 m, 0.05 rad) strictly for final millimeter-clearance pin/slot insertion (avoid tight on tabletop grasps or pushing where PD droop/friction is ~4-6mm), normal=(0.010 m, 0.15 rad, default; requires <=10 mm horizontal alignment with vertical contact/load compliance), relaxed/compliant/seating=(0.015 m, 0.20 rad) for compliant placement, coarse=(0.025 m, 0.35 rad) for large-clearance transit/retract, unconstrained_orientation=(0.015 m, 3.14159 rad) when wrist orientation around a symmetric target is free. Explicit position_tolerance_m, orientation_tolerance_rad, max_upward_dz_m or max_downward_dz_m overrides the corresponding component.

position_tolerance_m.description: Move only: measured link6 arrival position tolerance in metres, positive and at most 0.10. Overrides the position component of tolerance_preset (default normal=0.010 m). Tracking failure stops later stages, including gripper commands, and returns endpoint_residual_m={dx_m,dy_m,dz_m,position_error_m,orientation_error_rad}, first_divergence, contact_block_summary, in_hand_tracking_error (true when an object remains held between the fingers at a blocked pose) and next_action.

orientation_tolerance_rad.description: Move only: measured link6 arrival orientation tolerance in radians, in (0, pi]. Overrides the orientation component of tolerance_preset (default normal=0.15 rad).

max_upward_dz_m.description: Move only: optional upward +Z compliance window in metres [0, 0.15] when horizontal (dx, dy) and orientation are within tolerance and measured Z rests above target (+dz_m <= max_upward_dz_m). Defaults when omitted: 0.040 m when tolerance_preset="compliant"/"seating", max(position_tolerance_m, 0.040 m) when stall_guard_preset="contact_stop", and 0 m on all other moves. Set an explicit positive value (e.g. 0.04-0.12 m) for deep support/seating stops, or 0 for strict 3D Z arrival. Resolved effective_tolerances are reported in preview and stage_results.

max_downward_dz_m.description: Move only: optional downward -Z static payload-droop compliance window in metres [0, 0.15] when horizontal (dx, dy) and orientation are within tolerance and measured Z sags below target under held object weight (-max_downward_dz_m <= dz_m <= 0; default 0 m). Set e.g. max_downward_dz_m=0.020-0.060 m on loaded lift/transport/hover moves when held payload weight causes static joint-PD gravity sag while horizontal (dx, dy) stays aligned.

stall_guard_preset.description: Move only: real-time tracking divergence early-stop preset; off (default for batch, free-space moves, and pressing spring-loaded levers through resistance), contact_stop (0.020 m stall trigger during motion; stops at first support/object contact when horizontal (dx, dy) is within tolerance and holds the contact pose so attached gripper stages execute), or strict (0.010 m).

max_tracking_divergence_m.description: Move only: custom real-time tracking divergence threshold in metres [0.005, 0.15]; overrides stall_guard_preset.

clearance_preset.description: Move only: optional obstacle-crossing vertical clearance preset (none=0 m, low=0.09 m, normal=0.13 m default, high=0.18 m) when obstacles are supplied; mutually exclusive with clearance_height_m.

clearance_height_m.description: Move only: optional custom obstacle-crossing vertical clearance height in metres [0, 0.25] above obstacle top when obstacles are supplied; mutually exclusive with clearance_preset.

id.description: Unique ID within this batch; referenced by depends_on and returned stage results.

arm.description: Required for move/gripper. For observe, omit to wait for both arms' prior stages; name an arm to pause both when that arm reaches this checkpoint.

depends_on.description: Stage IDs that must finish before this stage starts. Same-arm order is automatic; add cross-arm dependencies only when physically needed. Independent left/right stages need none.

kind.description: Stage type: gripper.

goal_normalized.description: Gripper stage only, required: jaw target [0,1], 0 closed and 1 open. Command completion and measured aperture do not establish object retention. Use this exact field, not gripper, goal, or gripper_goal_normalized.

checkpoint_after_gripper.description: Move (with gripper_goal_normalized) or gripper stage only: optional on-demand boolean (default inherits batch checkpoint_after_gripper, which defaults to false). Set true to unconditionally pause both arms at the stage boundary before dependent move stages so you can inspect RGB and grip_facts and resume the cached plan_id.

grip_guard_preset.description: Move or gripper stage: optional aperture guard preset (none, non_empty [min 0.002m], thin_object [min 0.0005m], rigid_object [min 0.004m], wide_object [min 0.015m]). Choose from object thickness/rigidity: use rigid_object/wide_object (or min_aperture_m) on rigid blocks/bottles/tubes so an empty closure pauses automatically while a valid grasp continues; use thin_object or none on deformable cloth/thin sheets where a pinched jaw closes nearly to 0 m.

min_aperture_m.description: Move or gripper stage: optional minimum expected fingertip aperture in metres [0, 0.088] (full open 88mm, closed 0m; default none/disabled). Pauses with aperture_below_min_m if measured_aperture_m < min_aperture_m; overrides preset lower bound. Note that thin parts (<=3mm such as coins, cards, thin rims or cloth) can read 0.000m when firmly held, so omit min_aperture_m for thin parts.

max_aperture_m.description: Move or gripper stage: optional maximum expected fingertip aperture in metres [0, 0.088] (full open 88mm, closed 0m). Pauses with aperture_above_max_m if measured_aperture_m > max_aperture_m; overrides preset upper bound.

gripper_speed_scale.description: Jaw speed multiplier [0.25,1], default 1; choose this or gripper_speed_preset. On move requires gripper_goal_normalized.

gripper_speed_preset.description: Jaw speed: slower=0.5, slow=0.8 or normal=1; choose this or gripper_speed_scale. On move requires gripper_goal_normalized.

id.description: Unique ID within this batch; referenced by depends_on and returned stage results.

arm.description: Required for move/gripper. For observe, omit to wait for both arms' prior stages; name an arm to pause both when that arm reaches this checkpoint.

depends_on.description: Stage IDs that must finish before this stage starts. Same-arm order is automatic; add cross-arm dependencies only when physically needed. Independent left/right stages need none.

kind.description: Stage type: observe.

reason.description: Observe stage only, required nonblank text: what evidence to inspect at this checkpoint.

pool.description: 1..32 stages total, at most 16 per arm, on one shared execution timeline. Include both arms here for simultaneous motion. List order applies within each arm, not across arms; a global observe creates a barrier between preceding and following stages. A move with an after-arrival jaw goal expands into a motion and a jaw stage and consumes two stage slots.

Preview/preflight/execute_if_clean/direct: optional batch-default boolean (open-jaw grasp moves default to true when omitted; set false for strict finger polarity). When true on open-jaw move stages (jaw goal >= 0.90), tries strictly the exact 180 deg SO(3) parallel-jaw symmetric twin if primary angles_deg (deg) fails cuRobo IK or joint-travel (rad) admission; overridden by stage allow_jaw_symmetry.

Preview/preflight/execute_if_clean/direct: optional batch-default opt-in boolean (default false). When explicitly true on open-jaw grasp moves (jaw goal >= 0.90), allows fallback search over contact-invariant approach tilts (-15/+15/-30/+30 deg around the jaw closing axis at fixed grasp_position_m in env_origin metres) if both primary angles_deg and the exact 180 deg twin are infeasible; overridden by stage allow_approach_tilt.
Preview/direct only: batch-wide default move arrival tolerance preset (tight, normal, relaxed, compliant, seating, coarse, unconstrained_orientation); overridden by stage-level tolerance settings.

Preview/direct only: optional batch-wide default downward -Z payload-droop compliance window in metres [0, 0.15] when horizontal (dx, dy) and orientation are within tolerance; overridden by stage-level max_downward_dz_m.
Preview/direct only: optional bounded RGB stability check after the complete batch, never at a checkpoint; adds separate native wait steps. Requires robot_wait and a visible ROI.

Preview/preflight/execute_if_clean/direct: optional list of non-target intermediate 3D object IDs from the current observation_id (e.g. ["o1", "o2"]) converted into observation-scoped solid world AABB obstacles (m) to route over/around. Never include the target object or hollow racks, hooks, slots, or open containers being entered.

min_m.description: World AABB lower [x,y,z] corner in metres.

max_m.description: World AABB upper [x,y,z] corner in metres; each coordinate must exceed min_m. Both corners must lie in [-3,3] metres.

margin_m.description: Nonnegative clearance inflation in metres, default 0.01, at most 0.2.

evidence.description: Required nonblank description of current permitted evidence and estimation uncertainty.

arm.description: Holding arm; required when a single held_object is used with both arms.

pool.description: Preview/direct only: single held-object AABB; arm required for a dual-arm batch, otherwise inferred. Choose this or held_objects.
Inspect: summary (default) or full including selected geometry. Accepted but has no effect on preview/direct.
Inspect only: 1..3 distinct existing native-step IDs; mutually exclusive with pagination. Default selects first/middle/last.

image_delivery.description: Optional visual image policy ("none", "on_anomaly", "focus_roi", "head_only", "all"): omit on physical actions to use run default ("all": cam_head + both close-range wrist RGB + trajectory overlay in one reply). "head_only" drops wrist views; "focus_roi" attaches cropped ROI (px); "on_anomaly" attaches images only on stop/pause, slip_detected=true, or unavailable 3D; "none" suppresses images.

detail.description: Inspect: summary (default) or full including selected geometry. Accepted but has no effect on preview/direct.

native_steps.description: Inspect only: 1..3 distinct existing native-step IDs; mutually exclusive with pagination. Default selects first/middle/last.

held_object.description: Preview/direct only: single held-object AABB; arm required for a dual-arm batch, otherwise inferred. Choose this or held_objects.

arm.description: Holding arm; required when a single held_object is used with both arms.

settle.description: Preview/direct only: optional bounded RGB stability check after the complete batch, never at a checkpoint; adds separate native wait steps. Requires robot_wait and a visible ROI.

camera_id.description: RGB camera ID, default cam_head.

roi.description: Target pixel [x,y,width,height]; nonnegative origin, width/height at least 4, inside the image.

max_native_steps.description: Maximum additional wait steps, default 25, range 1..50.

sample_steps.description: Wait steps per RGB sample, default 5, range 1..10.

stable_samples.description: Required consecutive quiet comparisons, default 3, range 2..5.

max_motion_px.description: Maximum tracked-feature motion in pixels for a quiet sample, default 0.5, range 0..5; not proof of physical stability.

pool:
Capture current permitted RGB, same-frame measured joint/EE/gripper state and budgets. Returns observation_id, state/calibration metadata and images. Optional camera_id with roi/scale inspects a zoomed single-view crop of the current observation on demand without advancing simulation or replacing the current observation_id. No hidden object/score access. summary avoids repeating unchanged calibration; full repeats it. Head-camera observations here and in robot_action / robot_wait replies also carry the frame's VGGT-estimated object table (ids o1..oN: centre, top/bottom z, footprint, tilt, support, quality) plus a point-cloud artifact handle for scene3d_helpers; robot_observe adds an id overlay image. Examples (replace IDs/pixels with actual saved evidence): {}
Input field guide (use only fields applicable to the selected mode/kind):
input: Type: object. Object rules: detail is one of ["summary","full"] when supplied; only declared fields.
camera_id: Camera ID present in the selected observation, such as cam_head or cam_right_wrist. Optional unless roi is supplied or scale differs from 1; omission returns the current views. Type: string.
roi: Original-image integer pixels [x,y,width,height], fully in bounds; use the recorded crop transform to convert enlarged-image coordinates. Optional crop; requires camera_id and positive width/height. Type: array; Minimum items: 4; Maximum items: 4.
roi[]: Type: integer.
scale: Optional integer enlargement 1..4, default 1. A value other than 1 requires camera_id; changes displayed pixels, not source geometry. Type: integer; Default: 1; Minimum (inclusive): 1; Maximum (inclusive): 4.
detail: Optional summary/full. Omission uses the actor's configured display default (normally summary) or full for program calls; full repeats original evidence/metadata. Type: string; Allowed: ["summary","full"].

Capture current permitted RGB, same-frame measured joint/EE/gripper state and budgets. Returns observation_id, state/calibration metadata and images. Optional image_delivery selects 'none' (0 images; fast numeric state refresh), 'focus_roi' (1:1 native-sensor local crops around focus_3d), 'head_only' (cam_head RGB only) or 'all' (all calibrated views). Optional focus_3d projects a 3D sphere (target_m in env_origin m and/or detected 3D object_id such as 'o2', radius_m in m) through calibrated K and measured T_world_camera (including live wrist FK) to 1:1 native-resolution crops without advancing simulation or replacing the current observation_id, returning crop_xywh_px=[crop_x,crop_y,w,h], projected_center_uv_px and full_uv = [crop_x + local_u, crop_y + local_v] for geometry_query. Optional camera_id with manual roi/scale inspects a zoomed single-view crop on demand (mutually exclusive with focus_3d). No hidden object/score access. summary avoids repeating unchanged calibration; full repeats it. Head-camera observations here and in robot_action / robot_wait replies also carry the frame's VGGT-estimated object table (ids o1..oN: centre, top/bottom z, footprint, tilt, support, quality) plus a point-cloud artifact handle for scene3d_helpers; robot_observe adds an id overlay image. Examples (replace IDs/pixels with actual saved evidence): {} ; {"image_delivery":"none"} ; {"focus_3d":{"patch_px":256,"radius_m":0.06,"target_m":[0.0,-0.35,0.8]}} ; {"focus_3d":{"object_id":"o2"},"image_delivery":"focus_roi"}
Input field guide (use only fields applicable to the selected mode/kind):
input: Type: object. Object rules: image_delivery is one of ["none","focus_roi","head_only","all"] when supplied; detail is one of ["summary","full"] when supplied; only declared fields; all of (must not satisfy (requires focus_3d, roi) | if (image_delivery equals "focus_roi"; requires image_delivery), then (requires focus_3d) | must not satisfy (image_delivery is one of ["none","head_only","all"]; requires focus_3d, image_delivery) | must not satisfy (scale does not equal 1; requires focus_3d, scale) | if (image_delivery is one of ["none","all"]; requires image_delivery), then (must not satisfy (at least one of (requires roi | requires focus_3d | requires camera_id | scale does not equal 1; requires scale))) | if (image_delivery equals "head_only"; requires image_delivery), then (must not satisfy (at least one of (requires focus_3d | camera_id does not equal "cam_head"; requires camera_id)))).
camera_id: Camera ID present in the selected observation, such as cam_head or cam_right_wrist. Optional unless manual roi is supplied or scale differs from 1; omit with image_delivery='none'/'all', or use focus_3d.cameras for 3D multi-view crops. Type: string.
roi: Original-image integer pixels [x,y,width,height], fully in bounds; use the recorded crop transform to convert enlarged-image coordinates. Optional manual pixel crop; requires camera_id and positive width/height, and is mutually exclusive with focus_3d and image_delivery='none'/'all'. Type: array; Minimum items: 4; Maximum items: 4.
roi[]: Type: integer.
scale: Optional integer enlargement 1..4, default 1. A value other than 1 requires camera_id and cannot be combined with focus_3d or image_delivery='none'/'all'; changes displayed pixels, not source geometry. Type: integer; Default: 1; Minimum (inclusive): 1; Maximum (inclusive): 4.
image_delivery: Optional visual delivery policy: 'none' (0 images; fast numeric state/budget refresh without sensor image transport), 'focus_roi' (1:1 native-sensor local crops around focus_3d; requires focus_3d), 'head_only' (deliver only cam_head RGB image, skipping wrist images), or 'all' (deliver all calibrated camera RGB views, bypassing adaptive view skipping). Omission uses focus_roi when focus_3d is supplied, single-view crop when camera_id/roi is supplied, or the run's standard observation image policy. Type: string; Allowed: ["none","focus_roi","head_only","all"].
focus_3d: Optional 3D-to-2D back-projected native-resolution local ROI request in the env_origin frame; mutually exclusive with manual pixel roi and scale!=1. Supply target_m (3-element [x,y,z] in m) and/or detected 3D object_id (1..64 characters, such as 'o2'). Projects the 3D sphere (center target_m, radius radius_m in m, range 0.02..0.40, default 0.08) through calibrated K/D and measured T_world_camera (including live wrist-camera joint FK) and crops 1:1 native sensor pixels (patch_px 128..480, default 256) without downscale-upscale blur. Returns focus_3d.views[] with crop_xywh_px=[crop_x,crop_y,w,h], projected_center_uv_px=[u,v], local_center_uv_px=[local_u,local_v], full_uv_offset_px=[crop_x,crop_y] and pixel_transform; convert any pixel [local_u,local_v] picked on a returned crop back to original full-image coordinates via full_uv = [crop_x + local_u, crop_y + local_v] for direct use in geometry_query (triangulate / pixel_plane). Type: object. Object rules: only declared fields; at least one of (requires target_m | requires object_id).
focus_3d.target_m: Optional 3-element 3D target center [x, y, z] in env_origin metres (m). Required when object_id is omitted; when both target_m and object_id are supplied, this explicit target_m is used verbatim without background override. Type: array; Minimum items: 3; Maximum items: 3.
focus_3d.target_m[]: Type: number.
focus_3d.object_id: Optional detected 3D object ID (1..64 characters, such as 'o2') from the current or latest permitted 3D observation in this episode. Resolves the object's 3D centre_m (in env_origin m) when target_m is omitted, and resolves an adaptive 3D bounding-sphere radius clamped to 0.02..0.40 m when radius_m is omitted. Type: string; Minimum characters: 1; Maximum characters: 64.
focus_3d.radius_m: Optional 3D sphere radius of interest around the target center in metres (m), range 0.02..0.40, default 0.08 (or the object's 3D bounding-sphere radius clamped to 0.02..0.40 when object_id is supplied and radius_m is omitted). Explicit values are respected verbatim. Type: number; Default: 0.08; Minimum (inclusive): 0.02; Maximum (inclusive): 0.4.
focus_3d.cameras: Optional ordered list of 1..3 unique calibrated camera IDs (each at least 1 character) to crop (e.g. ['cam_head', 'cam_right_wrist']). When omitted (and top-level camera_id is omitted), automatically selects at most 2 frustum-visible cameras closest to the 3D target (preferring the closest visible wrist camera plus cam_head for stereo coverage). Type: array; Minimum items: 1; Maximum items: 3; Unique items: true.
focus_3d.cameras[]: Nonempty calibrated camera ID string (at least 1 character). Type: string; Minimum characters: 1.
focus_3d.patch_px: Optional minimum reference side length in native sensor pixels (px) for the local crop box, range 128..480, default 256. Crops 1:1 from the original full-resolution sensor image (display_scale=1, never downscaled then upscaled) and clamps [x, y, width, height] strictly within sensor bounds. Type: integer; Default: 256; Minimum (inclusive): 128; Maximum (inclusive): 480.
detail: Optional summary/full. Omission uses the actor's configured display default (normally summary) or full for program calls; full repeats original evidence/metadata. Type: string; Allowed: ["summary","full"].

Compute calibrated RGB/proprioception geometry from saved permitted observations. request.kind selects camera/FK, rays, triangulation, pixel_plane intersections with a caller-assumed plane, point/path projection, tracking, batch (1..32 geometry queries in one call via queries=[...]) or explicitly reconstructed-scene queries. Prefer triangulate across two calibrated views (such as head and wrist) when a target feature is visible and matchable in both views, since it measures 3D position without assuming a plane height. Use pixel_plane on demand when a target or destination lies on a known support/table/container plane or when single-view occlusion/weak texture prevents reliable two-view matching: it returns a conditional point (not measured depth), d_point_d_normal_offset_m and cross_camera_projections in other calibrated views, plus optional plane_origin_alt_m sensitivity (assumption_delta_m) and optional target_camera_id overlay image; verify the plane hypothesis via cross_camera_projections or target_camera_id before choosing robot_action targets. Returns numerical value, source/quality/degeneracy evidence and projection images when applicable. build_scene returns a proposed patch without applying it or creating a saved scene_version; scene queries require an existing saved version. No native object truth, movement or physics rollout. Projection images are returned as independent image items. Depth kinds use the depth_query contract only when RGB-D is enabled. In this run pixel_plane also accepts plane_source:'vggt', which replaces your plane height with an image-based estimate of the object's centre height at that pixel (alternate: its top); check value.plane_estimate.quality. Examples (replace IDs/pixels with actual saved evidence): {"request":{"camera_id":"cam_head","kind":"pixel_ray","observation_id":"obs_1","pixel":[320,240]}}

Type: object.

Compute calibrated RGB/proprioception geometry from saved permitted observations. request.kind selects camera/FK, rays, triangulation, pixel_plane intersections with a caller-assumed plane, point/path projection, tracking, batch (1..32 geometry queries in one call via queries=[...]) or explicitly reconstructed-scene queries. Prefer triangulate across two calibrated views (such as head and wrist) when a target feature is visible and matchable in both views, since it measures 3D position without assuming a plane height. Use pixel_plane on demand when a target or destination lies on a known support/table/container plane or when single-view occlusion/weak texture prevents reliable two-view matching: it returns a conditional point (not measured depth), d_point_d_normal_offset_m and cross_camera_projections in other calibrated views, plus optional plane_origin_alt_m sensitivity (assumption_delta_m) and optional target_camera_id overlay image; verify the plane hypothesis via cross_camera_projections or target_camera_id before choosing robot_action targets. Returns numerical value, source/quality/degeneracy evidence and projection images when applicable. build_scene returns a proposed patch without applying it or creating a saved scene_version; scene queries require an existing saved version. No native object truth, movement or physics rollout. Projection images are returned as independent image items. Depth kinds use the depth_query contract only when RGB-D is enabled. In this run pixel_plane also accepts plane_source:'vggt', which replaces your plane height with an image-based estimate of the object's centre height at that pixel (alternate: its top); check value.plane_estimate.quality. Examples (replace IDs/pixels with actual saved evidence): {"request":{"camera_id":"cam_head","kind":"pixel_ray","observation_id":"obs_1","pixel":[320,240]}}

pool:
Compute calibrated RGB/proprioception geometry from saved permitted observations. request.kind selects camera/FK, rays, triangulation, pixel_plane intersections with a caller-assumed plane, point/path projection, tracking, batch (1..32 geometry queries in one call via queries=[...]) or explicitly reconstructed-scene queries. Prefer triangulate across two calibrated views (such as head and wrist) when a target feature is visible and matchable in both views, since it measures 3D position without assuming a plane height. Use pixel_plane on demand when a target or destination lies on a known support/table/container plane or when single-view occlusion/weak texture prevents reliable two-view matching: it returns a conditional point (not measured depth), d_point_d_normal_offset_m and cross_camera_projections in other calibrated views, plus optional plane_origin_alt_m sensitivity (assumption_delta_m) and optional target_camera_id overlay image; verify the plane hypothesis via cross_camera_projections or target_camera_id before choosing robot_action targets. Returns numerical value, source/quality/degeneracy evidence and projection images when applicable. build_scene returns a proposed patch without applying it or creating a saved scene_version; scene queries require an existing saved version. No native object truth, movement or physics rollout. Projection images are returned as independent image items. Depth kinds use the depth_query contract only when RGB-D is enabled. In this run the pixel_plane plane height is estimated from the image (VGGT, centre height of the object at the pixel; value.plane_estimate) unless plane_source is 'caller'; a plane_origin_m you pass is kept as the alternate hypothesis (assumption_delta_m). Examples (replace IDs/pixels with actual saved evidence): {"request":{"camera_id":"cam_head","kind":"pixel_ray","observation_id":"obs_1","pixel":[320,240]}}
Input field guide (use only fields applicable to the selected mode/kind):
input: Type: object. Object rules: requires request; only declared fields.
request: Required query object with kind and the applicable fields in the tool description's input field guide. Distances use env_origin metres; pixels use original saved images. The gateway supplies episode identity; do not supply hidden state. Type: object. Object rules: exactly one of (kind equals "fk"; requires kind, camera_id; at least one of (requires observation_id | requires observation_ids) | kind equals "camera_pose"; requires kind, camera_id; at least one of (requires observation_id | requires observation_ids) | kind equals "pixel_ray"; requires kind, camera_id, pixel; at least one of (requires observation_id | requires observation_ids) | kind equals "pixel_plane"; plane_source is one of ["caller","vggt"] when supplied; requires kind, camera_id, pixel, observation_id; only declared fields | kind equals "ray_surface"; requires kind, camera_id, pixel, scene_version, entity_id; at least one of (requires observation_id | requires observation_ids) | kind equals "project_points"; requires kind, camera_id, points_m; at least one of (requires observation_id | requires observation_ids) | kind equals "project_geometry"; requires kind, camera_id; at least one of (requires observation_id | requires observation_ids); all of (at least one of (requires points_m | requires scene_version)) | kind equals "preview_ee"; requires kind, camera_id, action; at least one of (requires observation_id | requires observation_ids) | kind equals "sparse_track"; Compute calibrated RGB/proprioception geometry from saved permitted observations. request.kind selects camera/FK, rays, triangulation, pixel_plane intersections with a caller-assumed plane, point/path projection, tracking, batch (1..32 geometry queries in one call via queries=[...]) or explicitly reconstructed-scene queries. Prefer triangulate across two calibrated views (such as head and wrist) when a target feature is visible and matchable in both views, since it measures 3D position without assuming a plane height. Use pixel_plane on demand when a target or destination lies on a known support/table/container plane or when single-view occlusion/weak texture prevents reliable two-view matching: it returns a conditional point (not measured depth), d_point_d_normal_offset_m and cross_camera_projections in other calibrated views, plus optional plane_origin_alt_m sensitivity (assumption_delta_m) and optional target_camera_id overlay image; verify the plane hypothesis via cross_camera_projections or target_camera_id before choosing robot_action targets. Returns numerical value, source/quality/degeneracy evidence and projection images when applicable. build_scene returns a proposed patch without applying it or creating a saved scene_version; scene queries require an existing saved version. No native object truth, movement or physics rollout. Projection images are returned as independent image items. Depth kinds use the depth_query contract only when RGB-D is enabled. In this run the pixel_plane plane height is estimated from the image (VGGT, centre height of the object at the pixel; value.plane_estimate) unless plane_source is 'caller'; a plane_origin_m you pass is kept as the alternate hypothesis (assumption_delta_m). pool:
Capture current permitted RGB, same-frame measured joint/EE/gripper state and budgets. Returns observation_id, state/calibration metadata and images. Optional camera_id with roi/scale inspects a zoomed single-view crop of the current observation on demand without advancing simulation or replacing the current observation_id. No hidden object/score access. summary avoids repeating unchanged calibration; full repeats it. Head-camera observations here and in robot_action / robot_wait replies also carry the frame's VGGT-estimated object table (ids o1..oN: centre, top/bottom z, footprint, tilt, support, quality) plus a point-cloud artifact handle for scene3d_helpers, with an id overlay image. Examples (replace IDs/pixels with actual saved evidence): {}
Input field guide (use only fields applicable to the selected mode/kind):
input: Type: object. Object rules: detail is one of ["summary","full"] when supplied; only declared fields.
camera_id: Camera ID present in the selected observation, such as cam_head or cam_right_wrist. Optional unless roi is supplied or scale differs from 1; omission returns the current views. Type: string.
roi: Original-image integer pixels [x,y,width,height], fully in bounds; use the recorded crop transform to convert enlarged-image coordinates. Optional crop; requires camera_id and positive width/height. Type: array; Minimum items: 4; Maximum items: 4.
roi[]: Type: integer.
scale: Optional integer enlargement 1..4, default 1. A value other than 1 requires camera_id; changes displayed pixels, not source geometry. Type: integer; Default: 1; Minimum (inclusive): 1; Maximum (inclusive): 4.
detail: Optional summary/full. Omission uses the actor's configured display default (normally summary) or full for program calls; full repeats original evidence/metadata. Type: string; Allowed: ["summary","full"].

Capture current permitted RGB, same-frame measured joint/EE/gripper state and budgets. Returns observation_id, state/calibration metadata and images. Optional image_delivery selects 'none' (0 images; fast numeric state refresh), 'focus_roi' (1:1 native-sensor local crops around focus_3d), 'head_only' (cam_head RGB only) or 'all' (all calibrated views). Optional focus_3d projects a 3D sphere (target_m in env_origin m and/or detected 3D object_id such as 'o2', radius_m in m) through calibrated K and measured T_world_camera (including live wrist FK) to 1:1 native-resolution crops without advancing simulation or replacing the current observation_id, returning crop_xywh_px=[crop_x,crop_y,w,h], projected_center_uv_px and full_uv = [crop_x + local_u, crop_y + local_v] for geometry_query.
